tables.check_in_table: CREATE TABLE "check_in_table" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "energy" REAL NOT NULL, "focus" REAL NOT NULL, "motivation" REAL NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_synced" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_synced" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"))
tables.flashcards: CREATE TABLE "flashcards" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "subject_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES subjects (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "question" TEXT NOT NULL, "answer" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_reviewed" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"))
tables.focus_logs: CREATE TABLE "focus_logs" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "target_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "duration_seconds" INTEGER NOT NULL, "timestamp" INTEGER NOT NULL)
tables.goals: CREATE TABLE "goals" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "period" TEXT NOT NULL, "current_value" INTEGER NOT NULL, "target_value" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "last_reset" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"))
tables.habits: CREATE TABLE "habits" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "completed_dates" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"))
tables.health_entries: CREATE TABLE "health_entries" ("doc_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "mood" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '—', "water_intake_ml" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "has_taken_pill_today" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("has_taken_pill_today" IN (0, 1)), "menstrual_cycle_json" TEXT NULL, "date" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("doc_id"))
tables.medications: CREATE TABLE "medications" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "firestore_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "start_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "duration_days" INTEGER NULL, "end_date" INTEGER NULL)
tables.notification_dismissals: CREATE TABLE "notification_dismissals" ("notification_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "occurrence_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "dismissed_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("notification_id", "occurrence_key"))
tables.notifications_table: CREATE TABLE "notifications_table" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NOT NULL, "priority" TEXT NOT NULL, "module_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "route" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_read" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_read" IN (0, 1)), "is_completed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_completed" IN (0, 1)), "due_date" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "occurrence_key" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"))
tables.study_stats: CREATE TABLE "study_stats" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "streak" INTEGER NOT NULL, "review_queue" INTEGER NOT NULL, "progress" REAL NOT NULL, "last_study_date" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"))
tables.subjects: CREATE TABLE "subjects" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "cards_to_review" INTEGER NOT NULL, "streak_days" INTEGER NOT NULL, "progress" REAL NOT NULL, "has_exam" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("has_exam" IN (0, 1)), "exam_date" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"))
tables.sync_queue_table: CREATE TABLE "sync_queue_table" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "owner_uid" TEXT NULL, "collection" TEXT NOT NULL, "doc_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "operation_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_synced" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_synced" IN (0, 1)), "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "last_error_code" TEXT NULL, "attempt_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_attempt_at" INTEGER NULL)
tables.task_table: CREATE TABLE "task_table" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "priority" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_completed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_completed" IN (0, 1)), "date" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"))
tables.transactions: CREATE TABLE "transactions" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "firestore_id" TEXT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" REAL NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "category" TEXT NOT NULL, "date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_deleted" IN (0, 1)))
